versions.subject: Merge PR #4975 from @Murphy0801 - Add new rules related to GTFOBins
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '/awk'
        - '/gawk'
        - '/mawk'
        - '/nawk'
    CommandLine|contains: 'BEGIN {system'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/bin/bash'
        - '/bin/dash'
        - '/bin/fish'
        - '/bin/sh'
        - '/bin/zsh'
condition: all of selection_*
